node.statement: There are universal C_np<infinity and e_np>0 such that every finite-dimensional extended epsilon_X-C*-algebra (calX,I_X,.,dagger) with 0<=epsilon_X<=e_np and 1<dim_C calX<infinity contains nonvanishing C_np*epsilon_X-projections P' and P'' for the original product such that P'+P''=I_X and ||P'P''||,||P''P'||<=C_np*epsilon_X.
